# Silk (`silk`)

Draped satin rippling in a slow breeze, its sheen sliding down the folds.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: light (~2.8 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Silk

| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.6 |
| `scale` | Fold Size | slider | 0.4 … 2.5 | 1 |
| `sheen` | Sheen | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.4 |
